description: This header file declares the CvdInstanceLocalTest class used for unit testing components related to local CVD instances in the Android Cuttlefish project. It includes dependencies, a test class that inherits from Google Test, and method declarations relevant to testing initialization and command execution.

classes.name: CvdInstanceLocalTest
classes.description: A Google Test-based class for testing the local CVD instance commands, including methods to execute commands and initialize tests.

methods.name: CvdInstanceLocalTest
methods.description: Constructor for the test class, setting up necessary test environment.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Method to create a mock command line, execute it, and perform associated test flow.

methods.name: InitCmd
methods.description: Private method to initialize command-related configurations for the test.
